text: At length 26 the known letters give one check, yet design 2 noticed planted English against its own letters 5 times in 6 (0140). So K4 runs against scrambled copies of itself here too.
12 shuffles of K4 that still fit at 26; the same search on all 13. K4 scores -4.99, copies -5.05 to -4.69.
K4 ranks 12 of 13: the Beaufort-26 cell is closed at the measured strength. With 0140, one scrambled alphabet on both sides with no move is closed at every key length.
